features.name: Read intro pages on first run
features.match_note: No rule defines an intro or onboarding.

features.name: Set up the building on first run
features.match_note: Sites sit at the top of the place tree; no first-run setup.

features.name: See totals and charts of belongings
features.match_note: No counts, value totals or charts; value tracking is out of scope (R103).

features.name: Browse all items in a list
features.match_note: Items are reached by search, tags and places; no rule defines a list of every item.

features.name: Search by name, room, category or brand
features.match_note: Name and tag search with a place filter; search on field values such as brand is not defined.

features.name: Export all items to a spreadsheet
features.match_note: Export is JSON with photos, not CSV.

features.name: See an item's details
features.match_note: Item screen with its fields and state.

features.name: Edit an item
features.match_note: Every item fact can be set in any order.

features.name: Delete an item after confirming
features.match_note: Deleting an item is mentioned only in passing; no rule defines it.

features.name: Add an item with category and room
features.match_note: Only a name is required; quantity, tags and place are optional.

features.name: Add a photo from camera or gallery
features.match_note: Camera photos on items and places; picking an existing photo is not stated.

features.name: Record an item's value and brand
features.match_note: Brand is a ready-made field; value is out of scope for v1 (R103).

features.name: Pick a room or category from suggestions
features.match_note: Starter place names exist and R24 names a type-ahead picker; no rule defines picking from a typed list.

features.name: Keep adding items from a cleared form
features.match_note: Quick add by name exists; no save-and-add-next.

features.name: Choose a currency
features.match_note: Prices are in euro only in v1.

features.name: Edit the building's name, type and description
features.match_note: A site is a place with a name, tags and notes.

features.name: Report a bug or send feedback
features.match_note: No rule defines a feedback channel.
